variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: The address people sign in at, such as https://auth.example.com. Passkeys are bound to it: changing it later invalidates them.

variables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Encrypts stored keys and secrets. Make one with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: FILE_BACKEND
variables.description: Where uploaded images are kept: s3, or unset for the stack's own disk.

variables.name: S3_ENDPOINT
variables.description: S3 endpoint URL, for FILE_BACKEND s3.

variables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: S3 access key ID, for FILE_BACKEND s3.

variables.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: S3 secret access key, for FILE_BACKEND s3.
